Enrich Jira ticket {{JIRA_TICKET}}. It is not allowed to read or write files out of the current folder. If you need to write, use current tmp subfolder which is in .gitignore file. When you start, if the ticket status is "TO BE REFINE", move the task to the "REFINING" column; otherwise abort process. When you finish, if the last veredict is **APPROVED** or **APPROVED WITH NON-BLOCKING** move the ticket to the "REFINED" status, otherwise to "HUMAN QUESTION".
